verdicts.text: The best island for Christmas. Waikiki has the most holiday dinners, the most open on both days, and the lights. Book Halekulani first.
One great dinner. Hotel Wailea's five courses are the grown-up Christmas, but the rest is resort tables and Santa by canoe. Lahaina's banyan won't be lit.
Quiet and beautiful, and the volcano stays open. The big Christmas dinners are at Kohala resorts, and Mauna Lani only seats its own guests. Kona eats simpler.

A small-town Christmas, and a storm-scarred one this year: Poipu's Sheraton and The Beach House are closed. Merriman's and 1 Hotel Hanalei Bay have posted this year's dinners, the Thursday luau on Kalapaki Bay is the Christmas Eve night out, and Dec 23 to 27 is laid out day by day in its own section at the top of the page.

kauai_week.intro: Five days on Kauaʻi, Wednesday to Sunday, with every luau, holiday dinner, brunch, light show and market we could find, and what each kitchen is serving. Nothing is guessed: Confirmed means a 2026 page names the date, Likely means last year's pattern or a weekly schedule nobody could see on sale yet, and Not confirmed means call. Most places hadn't posted Christmas by Nov 8.

hurricane.text: Hurricane Lowell hit Kauaʻi on Sept 8, 2026, and the south shore took the worst of it. The Sheraton Kauai Resort in Poipu flooded and is closed with no reopening date, RumFire with it, and The Beach House is boarded up. Kilohana Plantation was only partly reopened in late October. Most of the island is open, with fewer staff and shorter hours, so confirm every venue by phone before counting on it.

items.name: Merriman's Kauaʻi
items.address: 2829 Ala Kalanikaumaka St #42, Koloa (The Shops at Kukuiula)
items.time: Both nights. Seating times aren't posted
items.price: $120 a person, three courses, plus tax and tip. Child price not posted
items.blurb: The only Christmas Eve and Christmas Day dinner on Kauaʻi with this year's price posted: a plated three-course prix fixe both nights at Peter Merriman's room in the Kukuiula shops. Tables are held 15 minutes, seatings run two hours, and a cancellation inside 48 hours costs $25 a person. Parties of seven or more call.
items.menu: Not posted. OpenTable says the menus go up at merrimanshawaii.com in early November, and they weren't there on Nov 8. Last year's Christmas Day entrees included roasted Chateaubriand of Hawaii Island beef and Moroccan-spiced Kona kampachi with clams. The restaurant's 2026 Thanksgiving prix fixe shows the format: one starter (hapa poke, kalua pork and Maui onion quesadilla, Caesar, beet salad, lobster salad for $10 more), one main (turkey, macadamia-crusted Kona kampachi, mahi mahi and shrimp, chateaubriand, Hanalei taro falafel, lobster pot pie for $15 more), one dessert, at $120 an adult and $45 for keiki 10 and under.
items.dietary: On the Thanksgiving menu the taro falafel was the meatless main and several dishes were marked gluten-free. A separate keiki menu exists.
items.check: The Christmas dishes aren't posted yet. Book the date now and read the menu when it lands.

items.price: $185 an adult, $85 for keiki 5 to 12, plus tax and tip. Ages 4 and under free with a paying adult. Parties of eight or more pay a 20 percent service charge
items.blurb: The grown-up Christmas Eve on the North Shore, in the old St. Regis above Hanalei Bay. The hotel reopened Sept 28 after the hurricane with no structural damage.
items.menu: Chilled seafood: oysters, shrimp, king crab, mussels, sushi and sashimi. Hot: lobster mango bisque, seared ono, braised kalua pork, potato gratin, ulu and kalo mash, butternut squash with vegan chorizo, roasted eggplant. Dim sum and a build-your-own noodle shop. Terrace grill: prawn and huli huli chicken skewers. Carving board: pineapple-brined turkey, bourbon-rubbed striploin, lilikoi-glazed pork loin. Salad bar: Caprese, kale Caesar, Nicoise, green papaya. Holiday sweets.
items.dietary: Dishes carry vegan, vegetarian, dairy-free, gluten-free and nut-free labels. A Keiki Corner has fruit skewers, sliders, mac and cheese, tater tots, chicken fingers and cookies.
items.check: The restaurant page calls it a hybrid buffet and the event page describes plated entrees, so ask which it is. Whether non-guests can book isn't stated.

items.menu: Last year: cream of mushroom soup with truffle oil or arugula salad; beef tenderloin carpaccio or shrimp Frangelico; fresh catch Oscar $65, seared Hokkaido scallops $70, braised oxtail $65, herb-crusted prime rib $65, surf and turf at market price, vegetable stack $58, portobello linguine $48 (add lobster $45, tiger shrimp $15, scallop $8); taro and guava bread pudding with eggnog creme anglaise, or blueberry or lilikoi cheesecake. Keiki 12 and under: chicken fingers or pasta, $21 a la carte or $35 for three courses. No substitutions.
items.dietary: The vegetable stack and the portobello linguine are the vegetarian mains. Gluten-free isn't marked on the Christmas menu, though the Thanksgiving menu carries GF, DF, NF and V codes.
items.check: In late October fewer than a dozen of Kilohana's 140 staff were working and the kitchen was on a limited basis, with a hoped-for full reopening Dec 1. Call before you count on it.
